translations.web: You shall cut the ram into its pieces, and wash its innards, and its legs, and put them with its pieces, and with its head.
translations.bsb: Cut the ram into pieces, wash the entrails and legs, and place them with its head and other pieces.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces, and wash the inwards of him, and his legs, and put them unto his pieces, and unto his head.
translations.asv: And thou shalt cut the ram into its pieces, and wash its inwards, and its legs, and put them with its pieces, and with its head.
